fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary centered on Miami mayor Everest George Sewell and city commission affairs, with discussion of Miami Beach mayoral politics. Contains coverage and tips related to horse racing (including Bowie and Texas tracks and the opening of Tropical Park), along with extensive radio program schedules for WIOD and WQAM. Also includes local business and nightlife items, advertisements, and notices involving Miami and Miami Beach establishments.
